motion.name: ordered-arrival-track
motion.purpose: Wide previews share one measured ordered track. Arrival-width clone caption/footer Range rectangles feed heroTextEnvelopes() for both iterative initial fit and travel; fit includes full clearance-fade padding. Actual rotation, signature/ordinary reading boxes, first curved horizon reading limit, entry/exit and clearance fades govern visibility. Creative uses its projected full frame/footer span. Hover/focus, Pause and preview selection stop ambient time. A short ultrawide opening may place Slide below the fold.

narrative.overview:
The selected C references establish graphite space, substantial silver lettering, blue interaction, a sharp portrait with warm rim light, and a shared celestial environment. The exact two-tailed Nekomata links this world to Huy. Project mechanisms occupy dark, lit frames; their imagery contributes color within the same environment.

This record describes the corrected implementation source. The user approved C and subsequently requested correction of the name, overlapping scroll copy, repeated transitions, and celestial materials. The visual authority is `docs/research/2026-10-03-concept-reset/mockups/c-name.png`, `c-mobile.png`, and `c-storyboard.png`; `PRODUCT.md` owns factual authority. This document does not record user approval of the corrected build or a passed visual gate. The latest responsive repair retains that type and replaces fixed hero geometry with an adaptive composition. Current source and component evidence are recorded here and under `docs/design/c-responsive-v3/`; the earlier native-scroll and type-restoration records retain their historical scope.
keyCharacteristics: Oppositely projected satin-silver name rows: Sora 800 H/U, scoped Barlow 900 upper Y, and Barlow 900 NGUYEN.
Manrope reading text and home mechanism headings; quieter Sora headings on reading routes.
A shared graphite, silver, blue, and celestial-light material family.
A square width-based portrait, intrinsic compact opening, measured ordered preview track, and curved satin reading edges.
Measured focus geometry, separate reading/departure windows, and three distinct mechanisms.
Native scrolling, complete static alternatives, and declared concept-art provenance.

rules.name: The Blue Interface Rule
rules.body: Keep blue attached to interaction and mechanism paths; keep scene light and subject colors local to their objects.

rules.name: The Identity Scale Rule
rules.body: Preserve C’s two projected name planes and satin material; scope glyph repair to the upper Y. Keep explanatory headings and reading copy outside the row transforms.

rules.name: The Mechanism Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep depicted objects spatial and contribution copy directly readable on the page.

dos: **Do** preserve the exact Nekomata and Huy's identity, rightward gaze, open zip hoodie, and neck headphones.
**Do** use the three approved C mockups as visual authority and `PRODUCT.md` as factual authority.
**Do** keep contribution, status, and concept/evidence provenance readable outside miniature art.
**Do** preserve scroll, keyboard/dialog behavior, static content, and recovery paths while correcting fidelity.
donts: **Don't** flatten or replace the approved name planes while repairing a single glyph.
**Don't** present generated collateral as product evidence or invent capability, release, customer, or outcome claims.
**Don't** use repeated generic transitions or artwork microtext in place of distinct mechanisms and readable contribution.
**Don't** claim current visual acceptance, approval of the corrected build, or closed gates from this source record.
